resources.string: Key uses (safety floor — usually leave as is)

Enter your seed phrase, key uses and the address of a Minima MegaMMR node.\n\nWARNING: this app uses the NEW block-as-key-uses key system. A seed from the classic MinimaCore app produces DIFFERENT addresses here — coins held on classic addresses will NOT appear. Sweep funds out of the classic app instead of restoring its seed here.
